# orchestration_cluster_tenant (Data Source)

Looks up a tenant inside a Camunda cluster by tenant ID or by name. Exactly one of `tenant_id` or `name` must be set. See the Camunda documentation on [tenants](https://docs.camunda.io/docs/components/admin/tenant/).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a tenant by its tenant ID.
data "orchestration_cluster_tenant" "by_id" {
  tenant_id = "my-tenant"
}

# Or look up a tenant by its (unique) name.
data "orchestration_cluster_tenant" "by_name" {
  name = "My Tenant"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the tenant to look up. Must match exactly one tenant.
- `tenant_id` (String) The unique ID of the tenant to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the tenant.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the tenant (the tenant ID).
